description: Questions a reader might ask about the reference pages of eval/quality_gate/readings.json, with the span of the reference that answers each. Each set was written by hand before any retriever was run on it: '2026-10' (35 questions) and '2026-11' (27 more). 'not_in_sources' holds questions on the same pages and topics whose answer the page does not contain; they have no answer span. See README.md. Used by scripts/benchmark_retrieval.py --questions.
